EchoLingo 0.4.0：历史记录 AI 笔记新增 PDF／图片视觉理解和自动插图。
EchoLingo 0.4.0 adds visual PDF/image understanding and automatic figures to History AI notes.

[中文](#中文) · [English](#english)

## 中文

### 更新内容

- 在 **History → Create notes** 添加 PDF、PNG、JPEG 或 WebP，勾选 **Allow sending PDF pages and images**，视觉模型即可理解图文课件、扫描页、结构图和手绘示意图。PPTX/Word 仍提取文字，需要图形时请先导出 PDF。
- 完整分批阅读 PDF 页面，结合课堂转录选择相关图表，自动裁图、检查完整性并插入笔记；不确定的裁图使用整页。插图保留文件名和页码，可点击放大。
- 图片上传单独授权；模型不支持视觉或页面读取失败时明确提示，不会悄悄退回纯文字。DeepSeek `deepseek-flash` 已登记视觉支持，其他模型先用无用户数据的图片探测兼容性。
- Markdown 导出包含配套图片文件夹，适合在 Obsidian 等工具中打开。只保留笔记采用的图片，替换、删除笔记和启动恢复会清理未引用资源。

### 安装与限制

- macOS（Apple Silicon，14+）：下载 `EchoLingo_0.4.0_aarch64.dmg`；Windows x64：`EchoLingo_0.4.0_x64-setup.exe`；Linux x64：`EchoLingo_0.4.0_amd64.deb`。已有版本可在 **Settings → General → Updates** 检查更新；Linux 提供下载链接。
- macOS 构建仍为临时签名、未经 Apple 公证；Windows 安装程序未做代码签名，首次打开可能需要手动放行。完整步骤见 [使用说明](https://github.com/Asphr726/EchoLingo#readme)。
- GPU 加速包必须匹配应用版本；Windows/Linux 用户更新后需在 **Settings → Models** 重新下载。
- 视觉理解取决于所选模型；手写识别、裁图完整性及笔记插入位置尚未完成真实 DeepSeek 课件人工验收。逐页读取会增加 API 用量和等待时间。
- 最多 5 个附件，每个 25 MB，PDF 每份最多 1000 页；保留最多 32 个按转录相关性筛选的插图候选，每个写作窗口最多 8 个。完整限制见 [图文笔记说明](https://github.com/Asphr726/EchoLingo/blob/main/docs/cloud-setup.md#visual-course-materials-in-history-notes)。
- 界面目前为英文；Linux 暂不支持系统声音采集，GPU 加速暂限符合要求的 NVIDIA 显卡。

## English

### What's new

- Attach PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP in **History → Create notes** and check **Allow sending PDF pages and images** to read diagrams, scanned pages and handwritten sketches with a visual model. PowerPoint/Word remain text-only; export them to PDF for visual content.
- Every PDF page is read in batches. Relevant diagrams are cropped, checked for completeness and inserted alongside the transcript-based notes. Uncertain crops use the full page. Figures have source filenames/page numbers and click-to-enlarge viewing.
- Image upload requires separate consent. Unsupported models and failed page reads produce explicit guidance, without silently switching to text-only. DeepSeek `deepseek-flash` is registered for vision; unknown models first receive a synthetic image compatibility probe without user content.
- Markdown exports include a companion image directory. Only selected figures are retained; replacement, deletion and startup recovery collect unreferenced resources.

### Install and limitations

- macOS Apple Silicon (14+): `EchoLingo_0.4.0_aarch64.dmg`; Windows x64: `EchoLingo_0.4.0_x64-setup.exe`; Linux x64: `EchoLingo_0.4.0_amd64.deb`. Existing installations can check **Settings → General → Updates**; Linux links to the download.
- The Mac build remains ad-hoc signed, not notarized; Windows is not code-signed. See the [installation guide](https://github.com/Asphr726/EchoLingo/blob/main/README.en.md).
- GPU packs match the application version; Windows/Linux users should download the new pack in **Settings → Models** after updating.
- Visual accuracy depends on the model. Real DeepSeek course-material validation of handwriting, crops and insertion placement is still pending. Reading every page increases API usage and waiting time.
- Up to five 25 MB attachments, 1000 pages per PDF, 32 transcript-relevant figure candidates and eight candidates per writing window. See [visual notes documentation](https://github.com/Asphr726/EchoLingo/blob/main/docs/cloud-setup.md#visual-course-materials-in-history-notes) for all limits.
- The interface is English-only. Linux system audio capture and non-NVIDIA GPU acceleration remain unavailable.
